attchmntText: CSM Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: CSM Technologies Limited confirms no deviation or variation in the utilization of proceeds from its Initial Public Offer for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company raised INR 145.78 crore on 30th June 2026. Funds were allocated for capital requirements, repayment of borrowings, inorganic growth, and general corporate purposes. The total amount utilized stands at INR 130.51 crore. The monitoring agency is Care Ratings Limited. The disclosure is filed pursuant to Regulation 32(1) of SEBI Listing Regulations. The statement was signed by Company Secretary Shweta Sharma on 13th November 2026.

attchmntText: Submission of Monitoring Agency Report under Regulation 32 of the SEBI for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026.
voiceSummary: CSM Technologies Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with BSE and NSE. The report was issued by CARE Ratings Limited regarding the utilization of proceeds from the Initial Public Offer aggregating Rs. 145.78 crore. The Board of Directors reviewed the report on November 13, 2026. The company utilized Rs. 113.93 crore towards issue objects and Rs. 16.58 crore towards issue expenses. There were no deviations from the objects of the issue. The company reported a consolidated loss of Rs. 8.28 crore and cash loss of Rs. 9.43 crore in Q1FY27. Funds were co-mingled through the cash credit account for general corporate purposes amounting to Rs. 36.21 crore.

attchmntText: CSM Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled " CSM Technologies Reports H1 FY27 Total Income of ₹86.28 Crore; Q2 Total Income at ₹43.04 Crore , ".
voiceSummary: CSM Technologies Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 13th November 2026. Total income for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 43.04 crore, down 35.1% year-on-year. Half-year total income was Rs. 86.28 crore, down 15.4% year-on-year. The company reported a consolidated net loss of Rs. 1,020.23 lakh for the quarter and Rs. 1,848.31 lakh for the half year. Paid-up equity share capital is Rs. 5,160.35 lakh. The order book stood at Rs. 357.63 crore as of 31st March 2026.

attchmntText: CSM Technologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: CSM Technologies Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The approval includes the Statement of Assets and Liabilities and the Cash Flow Statement for the half year ended 30th September 2026. Statutory Auditors M/s SRB & Associates issued Limited Review Reports on these results. The Board meeting commenced at 02:30 p.m. and concluded at 06:00 p.m. The company filed this information with BSE Limited and NSE of India Limited pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations.
